item.title: New terror group with reported Iran ties claims 4 attacks across Europe
item.summary: Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiyya attacks on European Jewish institutions may be linked to Iranian proxy networks, according to security analysts and Israeli officials.

item.title: US warns Iraq must act against Iran-backed militia attacks on American assets
item.summary: Iran-backed Popular Mobilization Forces have been accused of attacking U.S. assets in Iraq as Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani's government told to rein in terror proxies.

item.title: Pope Leo urges war leaders to halt fighting after deadly strike on school sparks outrage
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV called Sunday for an immediate ceasefire in the war involving Iran, urgently urging world leaders to halt violence after deadly strikes hit schools and civilian areas.

item.title: Iran arrests dozens accused of spying for Israel in new internal crackdown
item.summary: Iran says it has arrested dozens of alleged spies linked to Israel across several provinces, accusing them of sharing the locations of military sites and economic infrastructure.

item.title: Trump seeks warships from other countries to help secure Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Trump calls for international warships to secure Strait of Hormuz as Iran allegedly threatens global oil shipping routes from the Middle East region.

item.title: Exiled Iranian crown prince says he’s ready to lead Iran ‘as soon as the Islamic Republic falls’
item.summary: Exiled Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi says he's ready to lead Iran's transition as conflict enters third week and regime faces potential collapse.

item.title: Kim Jong Un appears with teenage daughter at live-fire rocket test in North Korea
item.summary: Kim Jong Un's daughter joins him at missile test, fueling ongoing succession speculation as North Korea escalates weapons demonstrations amid regional tensions.

item.title: Son of British couple detained in Iran 'let down' by Starmer's leadership on parent's imprisonment amid war
item.summary: The son of British prisoners in Iran slammed U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer's "non-existent" advocacy and urged President Donald Trump to remember prisoners during strikes on Iran.

item.title: Protesters torch Communist Party HQ in Cuba; video appears to capture gunfire
item.summary: Dramatic footage appears to show a protester on the ground after alleged gunfire as crowds attack the Communist Party building in Cuba, chanting "Freedom!" amid crisis.

item.title: Transactional partners: How 200-year distrust shapes Russia’s response to the Iran conflict
item.summary: From rivalry to military cooperation, the Russia-Iran relationship remains transactional. How Ukraine changed their strategic partnership dynamics.
